title: Remove kernel header dependencies from DKMS packages
author: ryanrhughes
body:
The base install supplies matching kernel headers before DKMS packages are installed. Remove the concrete linux-headers dependency from intel-ipu7-camera and macbook8-spi-pxa2xx-nodma-dkms so these consumers rely on that guarantee and cannot pull in stock headers on Omarchy systems.

Bump package releases to intel-ipu7-camera 1.0.6-2 and macbook8-spi-pxa2xx-nodma-dkms 1.0-2. Driver sources are unchanged.

Validation: makepkg --printsrcinfo confirms the IPU7 dependency removal. The MacBook SPI package was rebuilt with makepkg --force --nodeps, and its .PKGINFO lists dkms with no kernel-header dependency. CI passes (build-isolation and self-tests). IPU7 was not rebuilt locally.

Base-install guarantee: omacom/omarchy-iso#184. Existing-system repair and consumer cleanup: omacom/omarchy#11900 and omacom/omarchy#11901. Publish the runtime repair and these packages before building the next release ISO.

files.patch:
@@ -2,14 +2,13 @@
 
 pkgname=intel-ipu7-camera
 pkgver=1.0.6
-pkgrel=1
+pkgrel=2
 pkgdesc="Intel IPU7 MIPI camera stack for Hurrican/Performance (OV08X40 + hardware ISP)"
 arch=('x86_64')
 url="https://github.com/TsaiGaggery/hurrican_omarchy_enabling"
 license=('GPL-2.0-or-later')
 depends=(
   'dkms'
-  'linux-headers'
   'v4l2loopback-dkms'
   'v4l2-relayd'
   'gstreamer'

@@ -2,12 +2,12 @@
 _pkgbase=spi-pxa2xx-pci-nodma
 pkgname=macbook8-spi-pxa2xx-nodma-dkms
 pkgver=1.0
-pkgrel=1
+pkgrel=2
 pkgdesc="Patched SPI PXA2xx PCI driver forcing PIO mode for MacBook8,1 Wildcat Point GSPI (8086:9ce6)"
 arch=('x86_64')
 url="https://github.com/basecamp/omarchy"
 license=('GPL-2.0-only')
-depends=('dkms' 'linux-headers')
+depends=('dkms')
 makedepends=()
 conflicts=('spi_pxa2xx_pci' 'macbook12-spi-driver-dkms')
 provides=('spi_pxa2xx_pci_nodma')
@@ -31,4 +31,4 @@ package() {
 
     # Modprobe blacklist: prevent the in-tree spi_pxa2xx_pci from claiming this device
     install -Dm644 "${srcdir}/macbook8-spi-nodma.conf" "${pkgdir}/usr/lib/modprobe.d/macbook8-spi-nodma.conf"
-}
\ No newline at end of file
+}
